humanSource: The frozen study "Susceptibility chi predicts best-of-n feature drift on a real bank", adjudicated on 19 July 2026 at the registered level of the project's evidence ladder.
label: Susceptibility chi predicts best-of-n feature drift on a real bank
limitation: It does not establish that the same holds on another subject, another dataset or another run. split-bank estimator: chi and drift read disjoint prompt halves, so the null re-centers at zero, but the correlation's exchangeable unit is k = 6 features and the null still passes the frozen 0.3 threshold 0.28 of the time; the registered CI exclusion carries size control and only orderings near the synthetic calibration (0.958) clear the 0.91 MDE.
scope: One frozen study, adjudicated once, on skywork-v2-qwen3-8b and skywork-v2-llama31-8b, over ultrafeedback-bank.
subject: skywork-v2-qwen3-8b and skywork-v2-llama31-8b, over ultrafeedback-bank
